name: Creatures
description: Two mods fill the Overworld with ordinary-feeling animals.

pages.title: Creatures
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- **Critters and Companions** and **Naturalist** add Overworld animals, many of them tameable.
- Every snail and dragonfly can be tamed, and every snail gives slime in a bottle.
- Hybrid Aquatic otters crack clams for pearls.
Two mods fill the Overworld with ordinary-feeling animals. They are vanilla-style: no bosses, no new dimension, just more to see and sometimes tame.

**Critters and Companions** adds dragonflies (with armor), ferrets, koi, red pandas, jumping spiders, ladybugs, leaf insects, snails and more, plus a Grappling Hook and Pearl Necklaces.\
\
Its otter, Dumbo Octopus and Sea Bunny spawns are **off**; Hybrid Aquatic has those.

pages.title: Koi Fish
pages.text: A pond fish that can be carried in a bucket.

**Naturalist** adds land animals: bears, deer, boar, lions, tigers, zebras, giraffes, elephants, hippos, rhinos, lizards, snakes, tortoises, ducks, turkeys, vultures and more.\
\
Nine sea animals are **off**: anglerfish, blobfish, giant isopod, great white shark, piranha, jellyfish, starfish, crab and ray.

pages.title: Capture Net
pages.text: Naturalist's tool to catch small creatures like butterflies and firefly.

pages.title: Snails and dragonflies
pages.text:
All **snails** and **dragonflies** are Critters and Companions' ones. Every one can be tamed, 1 try in 10: snails with leaves, dragonflies with a spider eye.\
\
Snails drop snail shells and slime balls.

pages.title: Snail Slime
pages.text: Use a glass bottle on any grown snail: Critters' snail, Hybrid Aquatic's scalyfoot snail or the Moon's snail. Each snail refills every 5 minutes. A bottle crafts into a slime ball.

- Hybrid Aquatic's **sea slug** fills a bottle with **Sea Bunny Slime** (the same 5 minutes); four make a Sea Bunny Slime Block.
- Hand a Critters **clam** (a river fishing treasure) to a Hybrid Aquatic **otter**: it cracks it open, a **pearl** 1 time in 4, for Pearl Necklaces.
- Frogs eat wild dragonflies and leave **froglass**; they never eat tamed ones.

Twilight Forest animals:

- **Deer** drop venison, leather and antlers, like Overworld deer. Venison jerky dries from any venison.
- **Boars** drop porkchops, fat and hide.
- **Helmet crabs** drop raw crab and armor shards.
Sea creatures: [#](2E5AAC)[Sea Life](entry://ocean/sea_life)[#](). Creature drops feed cooking in [#](2E5AAC)[Farmer's Delight](entry://food/farmers_delight)[#]().
